summary: TrustCo Bank Corp NY filed an 8-K announcing its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.40 per share, a 5.3% increase over the prior dividend, equating to $1.60 annualized. The dividend is payable October 1, 2026, to shareholders of record September 4, 2026. CEO Robert J. McCormick emphasized the dividend increase alongside a robust share repurchase program, citing solid earnings and strong capital. This routine dividend declaration reflects ongoing capital returns. Watch for future repurchase activity or capital deployment updates as management balances buybacks with dividend growth.
